<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z ≈ 199.0, which corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]+. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral mass of about 198 Da. The formula that matches this mass most closely is C₉H₁₀O₅.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H10O5</final_answer>
